followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task-family fit. The query is open-ended creative/generative work (arranging songs into a soundtrack). Both models score essentially the same on Creative Generation (81.2 vs 82.7, within the 2.0-point variance band, so a tie on capability). With capability equal, I broke the tie on self-reported preference: Lapwing strongly prefers open-ended generative work (71) while Plover actively disprefers it (35). Routing to the model that prefers the task carries no capability cost here.
